name: The phone's timers
purpose: one sh loop as Android root (PowOS on the phone has no systemd): the App API health check every 10 min (unit app-api-health, its last result in /data/powos/state/app-api-health.txt) and both sides' units published to the PowOS AI page every 15 min (powos units publish), so a host there is never silently old
unbounded: one sh loop asleep 5 min at a time; each pass a health curl and, every third, one units snapshot per side
